identity.title: 22 Turbine Driven Auxiliary Feedwater Pump Actuation Signal Due to Procedure Error

cause.proximate_text: The cause of this event was a latent procedure error in SP 2083A from when the procedure was changed from testing both trains of the system to testing each of the trains separately.
cause.theme: procedure revision left prerequisite step out of alignment with new single-train test scope

nodes.display_name: Latent procedure error in SP 2083A prerequisite checklist
nodes.description: Prerequisite checklist not updated when SP 2083A was changed from testing both AFW trains together to testing each train separately, leaving the 22 TDAFW pump selector switch position instruction inconsistent with single-train testing.

nodes.display_name: 22 TDAFW selector switch placed in Shutdown Auto with buses isolated
nodes.description: Following the erroneous checklist step, operators placed the 22 Turbine Driven AFW Pump selector switch in Shutdown Auto from Manual while Non-Safety Related 4160V buses 21 and 22 were isolated for maintenance, completing the automatic start signal.

nodes.display_name: Unplanned AFW actuation signal / steam block valve opened
nodes.description: The completed automatic start signal caused the 22 Turbine Driven AFW Pump Steam Block Valve to open; the turbine and pump did not turn because the equipment was out of service with steam supply valves closed.

nodes.display_name: Valid PWR AFW actuation signal (reportable event)

properties.note: Steam block valve returned to closed on Low Pump discharge pressure signal; no challenge to safe shutdown
